scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev: node init && npx concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build:frontend: node init && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:backend: node init && npm run build --prefix backend
